terra.problem: Papa says he can barely keep his feet on his gold base, suggesting he can come off it. The base is part of him and always stays with him.
The passage calls the angel mighty, but does not say he is big. Having one foot on the sea and one on the land does not establish his size.
“That's the whole announcement” overlooks the angel's continuing statement about the mystery of God in verse 7.
The BSB says the nations were enraged in Revelation 11:18; it does not use the exact phrase “the anger of the nations.”
The claim about another part of Revelation needs its own reference.
The claim that Revelation discusses harvests elsewhere needs a reference, such as Revelation 14:15–16.
The claim that elders appear elsewhere in Revelation needs a reference, such as Revelation 4:4.
The passage does not say the angel is big.
The side-door joke treats the angel like a building, so the comparison does not match the action of approaching him.
The claim about sealed servants elsewhere in Revelation needs a reference, such as Revelation 7:3–4.
The effects occur in the order John experiences them, but the angel names the bitter stomach before the sweet mouth. They are not mentioned in the same order.
